attributes.description: Where externally kept infrastructure goes. A party's ciamTakesGeneratedInfra says whether it takes generated Terraform (absent: it is asked). The core's keepers decide who keeps each entry's blocks (the landing zone keeps its identities, guardrails, plumbing and GCP budgets by nature) and the root that gives: the stack's, a taking keeper's terraform/landing-zone[/<party>]/, or named and asked. Renderers stamp each entry's blocks with their origin, comment tails anchored to it. The Terraform format library splits a root N ways (imports follow their targets, lookups and providers copied where read, cross-root references become inputs plus outputs, cycles refused), regroups each root's files, prunes unused providers, lists asked keepers' resources and carries the files a keeper root reads. The clouds share its keeper-aware placement: roots by who keeps what, headers naming the cloud and the keeper, a keeper's network plumbing gathered from its bindings; each cloud passes only its title and its keeper roots' provider adjustment (AWS without the account pin, Google's project provider, Azure's providers.tf registrations). Every kept kind is placed by keeper on AWS, Azure and GCP: plumbing, landing zone, databases, object stores, volumes, snapshot policies, backups, audit trails, monitors, security services, suppressions, discovery, budgets. Asked keepers get one stack comment per entry. Scoped renders: flow 39.
